host.title: Hub host
host.description: Hostname or IP of the PowerView hub.

refreshShades.title: Refresh on read
refreshShades.description: Request fresh shade positions from the hub on every HomeKit read.

pollShadesForUpdate.title: Poll every 30 seconds
pollShadesForUpdate.description: Periodically poll the hub for shade position updates.

strictErrors.title: Strict errors
strictErrors.description: When enabled, HomeKit reads fail on hub errors instead of returning the last known position.

batteryPolling.title: Daily battery poll
batteryPolling.description: Off by default. When enabled, refreshes shade battery levels once a day. Each poll wakes every shade motor over RF: it is audible and nudges the shade, so do not schedule it near sleeping hours. Battery level still reaches HomeKit from ordinary hub reads without this.

batteryPollAt.title: Battery poll time
batteryPollAt.description: Local time of day (HH:MM) for the daily battery poll.

syncPositionsOnStart.title: Sync positions at startup
syncPositionsOnStart.description: Re-read shade positions over RF once when the plugin starts, for shades the hub has no position for. Wakes those motors briefly. Without it, a shade moved by remote can show a stale position indefinitely.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.description: Local-time window in which the plugin will not actuate hardware. Applies to the startup position sync, so an unattended overnight restart stays silent. Set both to the same hour to disable.

forceRollerShades.title: Force roller shade IDs
forceRollerShades.description: Treat these shade IDs as roller shades regardless of hub type.
